evidence: 100% of the hotel name appears on the page

verified_facts.text: The hotel is at 60 Huangpu Road in Shanghai's Hongkou District, on the banks of the Huangpu River.
verified_facts.excerpt: 60 Huangpu Road,   Hongkou District, Shanghai

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits at the crossroads of the Suzhou River, next to the Garden Bridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: From our prime location at the crossroads of the Suzhou River, just next to the famous Garden Bridge and the Grand Halls

verified_facts.text: The hotel is reachable by metro lines 10 and 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: You can also enjoy a metro journey to the hotel which is accessible by metro line 10 or 12.

verified_facts.text: Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is approximately 40 minutes by car and Shanghai Pudong International Airport approximately 1 hour by car.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shanghai Pudong International Airport is approximately 1 hour by car from the hotel, Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport is approximately 40 minutes by car from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was once The Seagull on the Bund hotel, dating back to the mid-1980s.
verified_facts.excerpt: This was once The Seagull on the Bund hotel, dating back to the mid-1980s

verified_facts.text: Historic elements of the former hotel remain, including a grand piano and a white stone spiral staircase rising to the second-floor banquet rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Historic elements of the former hotel remain today, including a grand piano and white stone, spiral staircase that rises up to the second-floor banquet rooms.

verified_facts.text: Each guestroom is designed to feel like a shipboard stateroom with an Oasis Bathroom, the majority overlooking the Huangpu River and Shanghai skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: each guestroom feels like an elegant shipboard stateroom with an Oasis Bathroom, the majority overlooking the Huangpu River and Shanghai skyline.

verified_facts.text: There are balconies in almost every room.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are balconies in almost every room

verified_facts.text: The Classic Garden Bridge View Room is a corner riverfront room looking onto the Garden Bridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: From your corner riverfront oasis, awaken to watch Shanghai come to life on the Garden Bridge

verified_facts.text: The Penthouse on the Bund has 270-degree views of the Shanghai skyline and historic Bund, a grand reception hall, an outdoor terrace and a private sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Penthouse on the Bund is home to a grand reception hall and outdoor terrace for entertaining, while the master suite’s intimate living room and Oasis Bathroom with an indulgent marble bath, skyline views and private sauna

verified_facts.text: The Seagull Suite is inspired by the property's heritage as the Seagull Hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: inspired by our heritage as the Seagull Hotel

verified_facts.text: Condé, on the fifth floor, serves Western cuisine with views of the Shanghai skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: CONDÉ exudes sophistication with its sculptural ceiling of shimmering dark metals, refractive curved walls and marble floors that contrast beautifully with the dazzling views of the Shanghai skyline.

verified_facts.text: Harmonia is the all-day restaurant with a garden courtyard and terrace overlooking the Bund and an open kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: in a light-filled setting with a garden courtyard and terrace overlooking the Bund. The open kitchen is a showcase of chefs crafting a fusion of global cuisine

verified_facts.text: Harmonia's breakfast buffet has live cooking stations including an area to watch handmade dumplings rolled.
verified_facts.excerpt: Its breakfast buffet has live cooking stations, complete with an area to watch handmade dumplings rolled a la minute.

verified_facts.text: Jin Lin, on the third floor, serves authentic Cantonese cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Authentic Cantonese

verified_facts.text: Condé Boutique, just off the lobby, is a pastry shop with a show kitchen, bar counter and garden terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: A stunning show kitchen reveals the creation of artisanal pastries, while the decadent display, convivial bar counter and garden terrace are a social hub over light breakfast and indulgent afternoon tea experiences.

verified_facts.text: The indoor swimming pool has tall windows with old Shanghai style mullions and a fountain.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the indoor swimming pool, natural light streams through tall windows with old Shanghai style mullions as the subtle spray of a fountain echoes the mist of the river.

verified_facts.text: The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
verified_facts.excerpt: the 24-hour Fitness Centre is a source of renewed energy

verified_facts.text: The indoor pool does not have views over the Bund.
verified_facts.excerpt: While it would have been nice to peer out over the Bund while swimming, the building’s design doesn’t allow for that.

verified_facts.text: The Condé Boutique and lobby lounge have no windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: There’s also the Condé Boutique and lobby lounge, but there is no view (no windows at all).

verified_facts.text: Weddings take place in the Regent Ballroom overlooking the Bund, reached by a classic swirling staircase.
verified_facts.excerpt: A classic swirling staircase is a glamorous pathway to the wedding of your dreams in the Regent Ballroom overlooking the Bund.

verified_facts.text: Families with kids are welcome; the breakfast buffet has a sweets, candy and chocolate fountain section.
verified_facts.excerpt: The breakfast buffet’s extensive sweets, candy, and chocolate fountain section is just one clear indication of that.

verified_facts.text: Minibars contain complimentary refreshments such as local beer, coconut water, soft drinks and dark chocolate.
verified_facts.excerpt: the minibars contain comped refreshments like local beer, coconut water, soft drinks, and dark chocolate candy bars

verified_facts.text: The hotel is minutes from Nanjing Road, just across the bridge from the main Bund promenade.
verified_facts.excerpt: You are right on the Bund, just across the bridge from the main promenade and minutes from bustling Nanjing Road’s famous avenue of shops and restaurants.

subjective.text: Only half the rooms face the Huangpu River.
subjective.reason: promotional wording; rewrite as a plain fact or leave out
